documents.text: Dear Guest, regarding your upcoming stay, please note that arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, requiring no earlier contact or request. Should you need to cancel before the cutoff, the entire payment is returned as money with no deduction. Please be aware that the accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Furthermore, neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied. We look forward to welcoming you.

Support Agent: Hello, I see you have questions about your booking. Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. Regarding the pool, the accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. On the hike, the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Note that the selected offer is Alder; the distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer. Also, while an unbooked offer policy states the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide with nothing further to pay, that does not apply here. Finally, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented.

Package Comparison Extract: Selected Terms vs. Old Policy. Under current selected terms, arrival and registration at 01:30 are not automatic; a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. The booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. Before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. These current selected terms completely replace the old policy, which previously stated that neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied.

Regarding arrival, a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Additionally, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented.
